title: Why AI Detection Fails for Academic Integrity
abstract: arXiv:2608.11256v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Institutions use commercial AI detectors for academic integrity, yet detectors cannot distinguish AI editing from full LLM drafts and may treat both as misconduct. In a controlled study of published English abstracts (four domains; 2013 to 2015 vs. 2023 to 2025), we quantify this policy failure under proxy human/AI labels at tau=0.50. Light "refine abstract only" edits, a proxy for guideline-compliant AI assistance, are flagged at 64 to 80% (Pangram/GPTZero). Unmodified 2023 to 2025 originals are flagged at 9 to 15%, with non-STEM rates far above STEM (p<0.001); elevated scores track long-token and Academic Word List density, not authorship intent alone. After Undetectable AI humanization, evasion is near-total: fewer than 4% of AI-labeled rewrites remain flagged (post-humanization detection rate <4%; FNR >96%). translated_title: 为什么AI检测在学术诚信中失效
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11256v1 公告类型：新 摘要：各机构使用商业AI检测器来维护学术诚信，但检测器无法区分AI编辑与完整的LLM草稿，可能将两者都视为不当行为。在一项针对已发表英文摘要的受控研究中（四个领域；2013至2015年对比2023至2025年），我们在代理人类/AI标签tau=0.50下量化了这一政策失败。仅进行“精炼摘要”的轻微编辑（作为符合指南的AI辅助的代理）被标记为违规的比例为64%至80%（Pangram/GPTZero）。未修改的2023至2025年原始摘要被标记的比例为9%至15%，其中非STEM领域的比例远高于STEM领域（p<0.001）；高评分与长标记和学术词汇表密度相关，而不仅仅是作者意图。经过Undetectable AI人性化处理后，规避几乎完全成功：少于4%的AI标记改写仍被标记（人性化后检测率<4%；漏报率>96%）。诚实的AI编辑导致比人性化辅助规避更高的制裁风险。因此，检测器分数不应作为...
tldr: 本文通过受控实验表明，商业AI检测器无法区分合规的AI编辑与完整AI草稿，导致诚实的AI辅助使用面临更高制裁风险，而人性化工具可几乎完全规避检测，从而质疑AI检测在学术诚信中的有效性。
en_tdlr: This study shows through controlled experiments that commercial AI detectors cannot distinguish compliant AI editing from full LLM drafts, causing honest AI-assisted use to face higher sanction risk while humanization tools achieve near-total evasion, thereby undermining the validity of AI detection for academic integrity.
